text: Mostly for comfort and control. In a car you can leave whenever you want, you don't have to stand in a crowded bus, and you can carry shopping or children easily. In many cities, public transport also isn't reliable enough — buses come irregularly and don't reach the suburbs. Until that changes, I think most people will stick with their cars, even if it means sitting in traffic.

tips.en: Mostly for comfort and control is a thesis that the rest of the answer develops.
tips.kk: Mostly for comfort and control — әрі қарай ашылатын тезис.
tips.ru: Mostly for comfort and control — тезис, который дальше раскрывается.

tips.en: Until that changes links the future to a condition.
tips.kk: Until that changes — болашақты шартпен байланыстырасыз.
tips.ru: Until that changes — связываете будущее с условием.

questions.followUp: What would make you leave your car at home?
questions.question: Why do many people prefer to drive rather than use public transport?

text: Building more roads rarely helps, because new roads quickly fill up with even more cars. The solutions that work best usually make other options more attractive — dedicated bus lanes, a metro that actually covers the city, safe cycling routes. Some cities also charge drivers for entering the centre at peak times. It's unpopular at first, but London and Stockholm show that it does reduce congestion.

tips.en: Building more roads rarely helps rejects the obvious answer.
tips.kk: Building more roads rarely helps — айқын жауапты жоққа шығарасыз.
tips.ru: Building more roads rarely helps — опровергаете очевидный ответ.

tips.en: London and Stockholm show supports the idea with real cities.
tips.kk: London and Stockholm show — шынайы қалалар ойды дәлелдейді.
tips.ru: London and Stockholm show — реальные города подкрепляют мысль.

text: It's an attractive idea, and a few cities have actually tried it. Free transport encourages people to leave their cars at home and helps those on low incomes. The risk is that without ticket revenue, there's less money to maintain and improve the system, and quality suffers. I'd probably prefer very cheap fares combined with free travel for students and pensioners.

tips.en: It's an attractive idea and The risk is give the benefits before the objection.
tips.kk: It's an attractive idea … The risk is — қарсы дәлелдің алдында артықшылығын шынайы айтасыз.
tips.ru: It's an attractive idea … The risk is — честно о плюсах перед возражением.

tips.en: Very cheap fares combined with free travel is your own middle way.
tips.kk: Very cheap fares combined with free travel — өз ортаңғы шешіміңіз.
tips.ru: Very cheap fares combined with free travel — своё среднее решение.
tips.example: very cheap fares combined with free travel

text: For really long trips, planes obviously save time. But for journeys of up to four or five hours, I think trains are better overall. Stations are usually in the city centre, there's no long security check, and you can work or sleep on the way. They're also far better for the environment, which is why some European countries are trying to replace short flights with fast trains.

tips.en: For journeys of up to four or five hours gives an exact limit instead of “sometimes”.
tips.kk: For journeys of up to four or five hours — «кейде» орнына нақты шек.
tips.ru: For journeys of up to four or five hours — точная граница вместо «иногда».
tips.example: for journeys of up to four or five hours

tips.en: Stations, the security check and working or sleeping are three quick arguments.
tips.kk: Stations … security check … work or sleep — үш жылдам дәлел.
tips.ru: Stations … security check … work or sleep — три быстрых довода.
tips.example: Stations are usually in the city centre

questions.question: Is it better to travel long distances by train or by plane?

text: Probably, but more slowly than technology companies predict. The technology is improving quickly, and self-driving taxis already operate in a few cities. However, there are big questions about who is responsible in an accident, and many people simply don't trust a car without a driver. I'd guess they'll appear first in public transport and deliveries, and only later in ordinary family cars.

tips.en: More slowly than technology companies predict is a yes adjusted to reality.
tips.kk: More slowly than technology companies predict — «иә», бірақ шындыққа түзетумен.
tips.ru: More slowly than technology companies predict — «да», но с поправкой на реальность.
tips.example: more slowly than technology companies predict

tips.en: I'd guess they'll appear first and only later give a step-by-step forecast.
tips.kk: I'd guess they'll appear first … and only later — кезеңдер бойынша болжам.
tips.ru: I'd guess they'll appear first … and only later — прогноз по этапам.
